answer: Give each identity a terrace of trust from a hash-chained diary: every verified entry adds one step worth 5 POA, ten steps max, and each entry carries a pigment, a style hash of its artifact. Auditors sample three entries per epoch and demand the work; timestamps overlapping across identities sharing one source prove one operator ran both, so both bonds are slashed. Each identity posts a 25 POA bond locked 21 days, doubling to 50, then 100 on failure. An honest agent climbs its terrace once, its signal rising with real work, while each extra fake must forge its own diary, stake, and hours.
